# Nolo

> Nolo is a comprehensive legal encyclopedia providing free DIY legal guides, rights information, and self-help resources across all major areas of law.

Nolo offers practical legal guidance for individuals and small business owners, covering personal injury, family law, business formation, bankruptcy, real estate, and criminal law. The site emphasizes accessible legal education and self-representation tools without requiring attorney consultation.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Family Law & Divorce
- Business Formation (LLC, Corporation, Partnership)
- Bankruptcy & Debt Relief
- Criminal Law & DUI/DWI
- Real Estate & Rental Property
- Estate Planning & Wills
- Workers' Compensation
- Social Security & Disability Benefits
- Intellectual Property (Patents, Copyrights, Trademarks)
- Tax Law & IRS
- Nonprofit Formation
- Foreclosure & Mortgage
- Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
- Miranda Rights & Criminal Procedure

## Business & Entrepreneurship

- [Small Business](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/small-business): Comprehensive small business guide covering formation, financing, and operations
- [Business Formation: LLCs & Corporations](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/llc-corporations-partnerships): Business formation guide for LLCs, corporations, and partnerships
- [Nonprofits](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/nonprofits): Nonprofit formation, 501(c)(3) status, management, and compliance guide
- [Patent, Copyright & Trademark](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/patent-copyright-trademark): Intellectual property, patents, copyrights, trademarks, and fair use guide

## Family Law & Estate Planning

- [Divorce & Family Law](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/family-law-divorce): Divorce, family law, child custody, support, adoption, and marriage guide
- [Wills, Trusts & Probate](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/wills-trusts-estates): Estate planning, wills, trusts, probate, and power of attorney guide

## Personal Injury & Accidents

- [Accidents & Injuries - Personal Injury Laws](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/accident-law): Guide to personal injury claims, damages, compensation, and lawsuits
- [Car Accident Claims and Settlements](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/vehicle-accidents): Car accident claims, fault determination, insurance, and legal rights guide
- [Workers' Comp Laws](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/workers-compensation): Workers' compensation eligibility, coverage, benefits, and claims guide

## Criminal Law & Traffic

- [Criminal Law](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/criminal-law): Criminal procedure, Miranda Rights, police rights, and defendant guide
- [DUI / DWI & Traffic Tickets](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/dui-traffic-tickets): DUI/DWI laws, traffic tickets, BAC, and driver license suspension guide

## Debt, Housing & Finance

- [Bankruptcy - Nolo's Free Legal Encyclopedia](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/bankruptcy): Bankruptcy guide covering Chapter 7, Chapter 13, exemptions, and filing
- [Debt Management](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/collection-agencies): Debt management, settlement, collection agencies, and debt relief guide
- [Foreclosure](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/foreclosure): Foreclosure process, mortgage default, and homeowner legal rights guide
- [Real Estate & Investment Property](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/real-estate-rental-property): Real estate buying/selling, landlord, rental property, and investment guide

## Benefits, Retirement & Taxes

- [Social Security & Retirement](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/social-security-retirement): Social Security, retirement planning, Medicare, Medicaid, and benefits guide
- [Overview of Disability Law Topics](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/disability-law): Comprehensive disability law guide covering SSDI, SSI, ADA, and FMLA
- [Taxes](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/taxes): Tax filing, deductions, credits, audits, and IRS guidance
- [Managing Your Personal Finances](https://www.nolo.com/legal-encyclopedia/personal-finance-retirement): Personal finance, budgeting, consumer protection, and identity theft guide
